newsitem.title: UK: BOE to auction 2.0 bln stg 8% UK gilts due 2021.
newsitem.headline: BOE to auction 2.0 bln stg 8% UK gilts due 2021.

text.p: The Bank of England will auction 2.0 billion stg of 8.0 percent gilts due 2021 at its July 23 auction, it announced on Tuesday.
The central bank said the bonds would strippable when an official gilts strip facility is introduced.
The Bank said interest payments would be made to all holders without deduction of UK income tax and that when issued trading might begin immediately.
